features.boundary: Truth authority remains replay and proof evidence, not dashboard presentation.
features.description: Anchors events, evidence bundles, replay verification, and state truth.
features.name: Trust Kernel
features.use: Anchors events, evidence bundles, replay verification, and state truth.

features.boundary: Execution is admissibility-gated and must not bypass declared contracts.
features.description: Executes domain operations through governed contracts.
features.name: AfriTPPS Execution
features.use: Executes domain operations through governed contracts.

features.boundary: Cross-system views expose evidence; they do not merge authority between domains.
features.description: Coordinates verified operations across multiple AfriTech domains.
features.name: Cross-Domain Orchestration
features.use: Coordinates verified operations across multiple AfriTech domains.

features.boundary: Federated peers may verify independently but cannot declare production activation.
features.description: Supports signed node communication and independent verification.
features.name: Federation
features.use: Supports signed node communication and independent verification.

features.boundary: Recovery and hardening artifacts are evidence-backed; they are not live pilot authorization.
features.description: Handles consensus failure, malicious nodes, replay divergence, and isolation.
features.name: Resilience Hardening
features.use: Handles consensus failure, malicious nodes, replay divergence, and isolation.

features.boundary: Intelligence may recommend or explain only; it cannot mutate truth or governance.
features.description: Provides advisory-only prediction, risk scoring, and anomaly suggestions.
features.name: AfriPower Intelligence
features.use: Provides advisory-only prediction, risk scoring, and anomaly suggestions.

features.boundary: Governance validates declared authority; it does not create runtime authority by wording.
features.description: Enforces ADR -> INVARIANT -> BINDING -> RULE -> GUARD -> CI integrity.
features.name: Governance Chain
features.use: Enforces ADR -> INVARIANT -> BINDING -> RULE -> GUARD -> CI integrity.

features.boundary: Classification blocks overclaiming; controlled readiness is not production proof.
features.description: Blocks false production, live deployment, and economic maturity claims.
features.name: Classification CI
features.use: Blocks false production, live deployment, and economic maturity claims.

features.boundary: Live riders, production field execution, and economic activation remain unauthorized.
features.description: Keeps AfriRide pilot execution evidence-gated and controlled.
features.name: Pilot Gates
features.use: Keeps AfriRide pilot execution evidence-gated and controlled.

features.boundary: Identity proof verifies signer and participant evidence only; it cannot override replay, proof, dispatch, or payment truth.
features.description: Exports signed driver identity and event-origin verification as a public trust feature.
features.name: Driver Identity Proof
features.use: Exports signed driver identity and event-origin verification as a public trust feature.

features.boundary: Trip integrity proof exports replay-verifiable evidence and does not authorize live field execution.
features.description: Verifies that trip lifecycle events, trace hashes, replay receipts, and evidence exports match.
features.name: Trip Integrity Proof
features.use: Verifies that trip lifecycle events, trace hashes, replay receipts, and evidence exports match.

features.boundary: Payment proof anchors prove exported payment evidence only; they do not activate settlement, pricing, escrow, or economic authority.
features.description: Packages payment and ledger receipt evidence into a signed, externally verifiable proof anchor.
features.name: Payment Proof Anchor
features.use: Packages payment and ledger receipt evidence into a signed, externally verifiable proof anchor.

features.boundary: Planned product surfaces must remain planned until implementation and replay evidence exist.
features.description: Defines bounded surfaces for AfriRide, AfriConnectTL, AfriEats, and AfriPay.
features.name: Domain Surfaces
features.use: Defines bounded surfaces for AfriRide, AfriConnectTL, AfriEats, and AfriPay.

features.boundary: Evidence export is review material and must be independently replay-verifiable.
features.description: Packages replayable evidence for jurisdiction-aware review.
features.name: Legal Evidence Export
features.use: Packages replayable evidence for jurisdiction-aware review.

features.boundary: Tooling visualizes and validates evidence; it does not override replay or governance.
features.description: Provides CLI, inspectors, validators, and pilot readiness checks.
features.name: Operational Tooling
features.use: Provides CLI, inspectors, validators, and pilot readiness checks.
